name: Holographic 3D display system based on SLM
aliases: Holographic 3D display system based on liquid crystal spatial light modulator or digital micromirror device
definition: A processing method using either liquid crystal spatial light modulators (modulating light via electro-optic effect) or digital micromirror devices (controlling mirror reflection direction via voltage to switch light on/off) to modulate incident light for holographic reconstruction.
summary: This system physically reconstructs 3D optical fields from computer-generated holograms using spatial light modulators and coherent light, differing from pure calculation methods by focusing on the hardware reconstruction pipeline.
